title: Which Box Hides the Puppy?
youtube_title: 🐶 Can You Find the Hidden Puppy? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Three boxes, one hidden puppy — can YOU guess which one? Watch to find out! 🐾 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Puppy #FunForKids #Kidify #BrainTeaser #CutePuppy

scenes.narration: A puppy is hiding in one of these three boxes — but which one?
Is it the red box, the blue box, or the yellow box? Take a guess!
The answer is coming — three, two, one!
The red box — oh no, it's just a rubber chicken! Bawk bawk!
The blue box — whoops, it's a pile of smelly socks! Ewww!
The yellow box — yes! There's the puppy! You found it! Good job!
Did you get it right? Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it gets trickier!
